samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>Implement an ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">A 6-bit control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit output representing the result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">A 1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">A 1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">A 1-bit output representing a general flag, which is set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">ADD = 6'b100000.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">ADDU = 6'b100001.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">SUB = 6'b100010.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">SUBU = 6'b100011.</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">AND = 6'b100100.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">OR = 6'b100101.</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">XOR = 6'b100110.</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">NOR = 6'b100111.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">SLT = 6'b101010.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">SLTU = 6'b101011.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">SLL = 6'b000000.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">SRL = 6'b000010.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">SRA = 6'b000011.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">SLLV = 6'b000100.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">SRLV = 6'b000110.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">SRAV = 6'b000111.</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">LUI = 6'b001111.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <sequential_logic>
            <reg id="res" width_description="[32:0]">A 33-bit register to hold the result of the operation.</reg>
        </sequential_logic>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <description>Reset the result to 0.</description>
        <always>
            <sequential_logic>
                <non_blocking>
                    <reg id="res">33'b0</reg>
                </non_blocking>
            </sequential_logic>
        </always>
        <description>Perform the operation based on the control signal.</description>
        <always>
            <combinational_logic>
                <case>
                    <case_item>
                        <condition>
                            <id>aluc</id>
                            <equals>
                                <id>ADD</id>
                            </equals>
                        </condition>
                        <action>
                            <description>Add the two input operands.</description>
                            <assign>
                                <id>res</id>
                                <value>
                                    <binary>
                                        <id>a</id>
                                        <plus>
                                            <id>b</id>
                                        </plus>
                                    </binary>
                                </value>
                            </assign>
                        </action>
                    </case_item>
                    <case_item>
                        <condition>
                            <id>aluc</id>
                            <equals>
                                <id>ADDU</id>
                            </equals>
                        </condition>
                        <action>
                            <description>Add the two input operands.</description>
                            <assign>
                                <id>res</id>
                                <value>
                                    <binary>
                                        <id>a</id>
                                        <plus>
                                            <id>b</id>
                                        </plus>
                                    </binary>
                                </value>
                            </assign>
                        </action>
                    </case_item>
                    <case_item>
                        <condition>
                            <id>aluc</id>
                            <equals>
                                <id>SUB</id>
                            </equals>
                        </condition>
                        <action>
                            <description>Subtract the two input operands.</description>
                            <assign>
                                <id>res</id>
                                <value>
                                    <binary>
                                        <id>a</id>
                                        <minus>
                                            <id>b</id>
                                        </minus>
                                    </binary>
                                </value>
                            </assign>
                        </action>
                    </case_item>
                    <case_item>
                        <condition>
                            <id>aluc</id>
                            <equals>
                                <id>SUBU</id>
                            </equals>
                        </condition>
                        <action>
                            <description>Subtract the two input operands.</description>
                            <assign>
                                <id>res</id>
                                <value>
                                    <binary>
                                        <id>a</id>
                                        <minus>
                                            <id>b</id>
                                        </minus>
                                    </binary>
                                </value>
                            </assign>
                        </action>
                    </case_item>
                    <case_item>
                        <condition>
                            <id>aluc</id>
                            <equals>
                                <id>AND</id>
                            </equals>
                        </condition>
                        <action>
                            <description>Bitwise AND of the two input operands.</description>
                            <assign>
                                <id>res</id>
                                <value>
                                    <binary>
                                        <id>a</id>
                                        <bitwise_and>
                                            <id>b</id>
                                        </bitwise_and>
                                    </binary>
                                </value>
                            </assign>
                        </action>
                    </case_item>
                    <case_item>
                        <condition>
                            <id>aluc</id>
                            <equals>
                                <id>OR</id>
                            </equals>
                        </condition>
                        <action>
                            <description>Bitwise OR of the two input operands.</description>
                            <assign>
                                <id>res</id>
                                <value>
                                    <binary>
                                        <id>a</id>
                                        <bitwise_or>
                                            <id>b</id>
                                        </bitwise_or>
                                    </binary>
                                </value>
                            </assign>
                        </action>
                    </case_item>
                    <case_item>
                        <condition>
                            <id>aluc</id>
                            <equals>
                                <id>XOR</id>
                            </equals>
                        </condition>
                        <action>
                            <description>Bitwise XOR of the two input operands.</description>
                            <assign>
                                <id>res</id>
                                <value>
                                    <binary>
                                        <id>a</id>
                                        <bitwise_xor>
                                            <id>b</id>
                                        </bitwise_xor>
                                    </binary>
                                </value>
                            </assign>
                        </action>
                    </case_item>
                    <case_item>
                        <condition>
                            <id>aluc</id>
                            <equals>
                                <id>NOR</id>
                            </equals>
                        </condition>
                        <action>
                            <description>Bitwise NOR of the two input operands.</description>
                            <assign>
                                <id>res</id>
                                <value>
                                    <binary>
                                        <id>a</id>
                                        <bitwise_nor>
                                            <id>b</id>
                                        </bitwise_nor>
                                    </binary>
                                </value>
                            </assign>
                        </action>
                    </case_item>
                    <case_item>
                        <condition>
                            <id>aluc</id>
                            <equals>
                                <id>SLT</id>
                            </equals>
                        </condition>
                        <action>
                            <description>Set the result to 1 if the first operand is less than the second operand.</description>
                            <assign>
                                <id>res</id>
                                <value>
                                    <binary>
                                        <id>a</id>
                                        <less_than>
                                            <id>b</id>
                                        </less_than>
                                    </binary>
                                </value>
                            </assign>
                        </action>
                    </case_item>
                    <case_item>
                        <condition>
                            <id>aluc</id>
                            <equals>
                                <id>SLTU</id>
                            </equals>
                        </condition>
                        <action>
                            <description>Set the result to 1 if the first operand is less than the second operand.</description>
                            <assign>
                                <id>res</id>
                                <value>
                                    <binary>
                                        <id>a</id>
                                        <less_than_unsigned>
                                            <id>b</id>
                                        </less_than_unsigned>
                                    </binary>
                                </value>
                            </assign>
                        </action>
                    </case_item>
                    <case_item>
